post.summary: Applies channel `id`, holding the global lock throughout: every light off, the filter, the
post.description:
## Applies channel `id`, holding the global lock throughout: every light off, the filter, the

Applies channel `id`, holding the global lock throughout: every light off, the filter, the
exposure and the display colour, then the channel's light. Frames exposed meanwhile have no
channel.

## Important note

This `POST` request starts an action: the server may carry on after answering. The answer is always a 201 with the invocation, whose `href` can be polled to follow it, and whose `output` link gives the result when it has completed.

201.description: Action has been invoked (and may still be running).
